about: Chemistry quests (docs/loop/items/I-053/spec.md section 6): side quests that need a discovered reaction with the right effect, not just good aim. A quest completes when a discovered spell whose effect matches `needs` lands and the world reports `event` within `radius_m` of it in the same moment. `live` quests run in the block world now; the others are specified for later.

quests.title: Smother a fire with a reaction's gas
Cool a hot steam vent with a reaction that takes in heat
Make a cloud in the well with a precipitation reaction
